title: The number of multiplicity sets of n-point plane line collections grows as exp(Theta(sqrt(n)))
summary: For a set P of n points in the plane R^2, let A(P) be the set of multiplicities of P, i.e. the sizes |ell cap P| >= 2 of the subsets of P lying on a common line ell, and let F(n) be the number of distinct multiplicity sets A(P) as P ranges over all n-point sets. Erdos problem 607 (erdosproblems.com/607) asks whether F(n) 0. The proof is a three-step reduction to a published result of Colbourn-Phelps-Rodl, "Block sizes in pairwise balanced designs" (Canad.
